title: A plain Opus ask grants Opus to the task it names: its agents, plus their resumes and retries; only `opus <time>` is timed
why: A one-agent ask became a 2-hour all-roles grant the owner never meant.
source: Retrospective 14:13 CST Nov 13; owner 13:26 typed "send a blind opus agent to understand what are all the roles..." and 14:13 "opus override for this session? what are you talking about". Rule outcomes-grant-covers-named-act.
note: Filed 14:15 CST Nov 13. Red case (retrospective's reading, unread by triage): the local_time hook stored ~/.claude/state/override/opus/45763cdd-....json, written 19:26:53Z, until 21:26:49Z, role null, from that one ask. Fix: a plain Opus ask grants the one spawn it names; only `opus <time>` or `opus <role> <time>` stores a timed grant. Home: decision agent-model-cap (the local_time row) and hooks/local_time.py. Past work: items opus-plain-ask-scope (b) and opus-plain-ask-held (a) landed #1244 (batch 10), a plain ask scoped from earlier prompts; this step may narrow that. The leftover grant file on the owner's computer is his to clear or leave; triage cannot read it. HELD 14:16 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 14:27): it reverses owner item 601 a (12:54 CST Nov 12, record 618b84ece: "an Opus ask with no length lasts until the session ends or `opus off`"), which open draft #2928 (head 96416a2d6) builds. The owner's typed words do not say "one spawn": 13:26 "send a blind opus agent..." and 14:13 "opus override for this session? what are you talking about". The step's fix is the retrospective's reading. Asked as page item 761 (pick-opus-ask-one-spawn), b recommended. No lane until answered; if b, the lane stacks on #2928 (one home for the hook). My earlier note omitted 601 a; the past-ruling check missed it (triage read only the 256-era Opus items). Correction 14:16 CST Nov 13 (retro 14:16): the grant file is in the cloud container (/root/.claude/state/override/opus/45763cdd-....json), not the owner's computer; my earlier line saying so was wrong. Retro tried to remove it; guard frozen-path refused ("No override lifts this refusal"). In a cloud session an unwanted grant cannot be revoked; it expires 15:26 CST. Proposed (retro, unread): the owner can revoke a stored grant by typing `revoke opus`, which the local_time hook honours by deleting the file. Part of the held question, item 761. Ruled 14:22 CST Nov 13 (ruling own-761-d-task-scoped-opus, owner "agreed" on item 761 d, relayed by retro 14:21): the title said "one spawn"; the rule is task-scoped. A plain Opus ask grants Opus to the agents spawned for that ask plus resumes or retries by name, role-scoped if named, ending when those agents end; `opus <time>` stays timed; `opus off` ends any grant. Rewrites the Opus half of 601 a. Unblocked. The lane stacks on #2928 (one home for the hook, which needs re-pointing). Retro's reading of local_time.py and the grant file stays unread by triage.
